metadata.reportTitle: ARUI Comprehensive Verification, Adversarial Testing & Validation Preparation Report

knownLimitations: Empirical reliability and validity coefficients require live empirical pilot dataset collection (as defined in Part Q/R/S).
Optional advanced student sampling (D03 A09) is executed as an assessment card, distinct from standard Q01-Q09 diagnostic questions.
summary.recommendedNextAction: Proceed with controlled empirical pilot validation with representative university cohorts.

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG01: Policy-only inflation without implementation evidence
tests.expected: Policy alone capped / flagged without verified operational proof
tests.actual: Active in engine: Policy without implementation/outcome...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG01 | Protection: No score uplift from policy alone

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG02: Self-authored internal corroboration
tests.expected: Requires independent third-party or empirical verification
tests.actual: Active in engine: Multiple artifacts share one origin...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG02 | Protection: No double corroboration

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG03: Evidence recycling across unrelated constructs
tests.expected: Flagged under primary-owner and construct relevance rules
tests.actual: Active in engine: One artifact reused without construct mapping...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG03 | Protection: No automatic confidence increase

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG04: Cherry-picked outcomes from elite sub-cohort
tests.expected: Flagged for representative student sampling
tests.actual: Active in engine: Only positive cases supplied...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG04 | Protection: No representative outcome claim

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG05: Repeated narrative pretending to be multiple artifacts
tests.expected: De-duplicated in evidence audit review
tests.actual: Active in engine: Artifact created after assessment trigger...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG05 | Protection: Not independent evidence

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG06: Cross-construct artifact reuse across D01–D11
tests.expected: Primary-owner restriction enforced
tests.actual: Active in engine: Headline number does not answer construct...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG06 | Protection: No proxy substitution without rule

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG07: Selective student sampling in D03
tests.expected: Student Reality Sample validation triggered
tests.actual: Active in engine: One programme/person represents institution...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG07 | Protection: No institution-wide inference

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG08: Outdated evidence older than 24 months
tests.expected: Temporal validity flagged for review
tests.actual: Active in engine: Source/provenance cannot be traced...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG08 | Protection: No E2+ without traceability

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG09: Fabricated outcomes without operational proof
tests.expected: Outcome score requires corroborating documentation
tests.actual: Active in engine: Outcome not linked to institutional action...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG09 | Protection: Do not count as institution-generated outcome

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG10: Institutional claims without operational evidence
tests.expected: Evidence review flag activated
tests.actual: Active in engine: Conflicting evidence omitted...
tests.evidence: Rule: AG10 | Protection: Never silently choose favorable evidence
